premises: A VZrHfNbTa HEA substrate coated with hafnium forms a HfZr alloy transition layer during high-temperature sintering.
This HfZr transition layer chemically combines the hafnium coating and the HEA substrate into a monolithic alloy composite.
The coated composite shows significantly lower weight gain (57.7%) than the uncoated HEA after oxidation at 1873 K.
The hafnium coating forms a dense HfO2 protective layer that reduces internal oxidation.
